name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
title: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd - 544279 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA rebounded to INR92 crores (16.2% margin) on sugar crushing, but bio-chem and ethanol commentary is qualitative with no capacity-utilisation or pricing numbers; the 60 million litre grain distillery is still unproven and maize economics are undisclosed.

triggers.label: 200 KLPD distillery commissioning trials June
triggers.quote: we are progressing well on our 200 KLPD grain-based distillery, expected to commission by June 2026

triggers.label: Ethanol prices set by government, no revision
triggers.quote: The price revisions for ethanol are a subject matter for the Government of India to decide.

guidance.value: stronger outlook from this quarter onwards
guidance.quote: we are seeing a stronger outlook in this financial year and this will be apparent from in the -- from this quarter onwards
we are targeting commissioning trials next month

red_flags.label: Specialty mix fell 61% vs 58% framing; ethyl acetate commodity pivot
red_flags.quote: if we do see an opportunity in ethyl acetate margins with our ethanol production, we are large producers of ethanol

red_flags.label: Sugar margin squeeze from cane price, no MSP or ethanol price rise
red_flags.quote: did not increase the MSP of sugar and neither did they increase the price of the ethanol blend

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT driven by sugar season; FY26 PAT only INR3.5 crores
red_flags.quote: we reported a positive profit after tax of INR3.5 crores compared to a loss in FY 2025

evasions.topic: Ethanol price revision timing and magnitude
evasions.quote: The answer, I am not sure I can have for you.

evasions.topic: Distillery economics: capex, asset turns, EBITDA potential
evasions.quote: it will also depend on the government ethanol blending program and its targets and prices
No, ma'am. This multi-feedstock will happen once the maize facility is in place
